cases.sentence: На ___ были у фельдмаршала обед и бал, которые государь удостоил своим присутствием.
cases.explain: «другой день» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Next day the field marshal gave a dinner and ball which the Emperor honored by his presence. Kutúzov had received the Order of St. George of the First Class and the Emperor showed him the highest honors, but everyone knew of the imperial dissatisfaction with him. The proprieties were observed and the Emperor was the first to set that example, but everybody understood that the old man was blameworthy and good-for-nothing. When Kutúzov, conforming to a custom of Catherine’s day, ordered the standards that had been captured to be lowered at the Emperor’s feet on his entering the ballroom, the Emperor made a wry face and muttered something in which some people caught the words, “the old comedian.”

cases.sentence: Соблюдалось приличие, и государь показывал ___ этого; но все знали, что старик виноват и никуда не годится.
cases.explain: «первый пример» — the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: Next day the field marshal gave a dinner and ball which the Emperor honored by his presence. Kutúzov had received the Order of St. George of the First Class and the Emperor showed him the highest honors, but everyone knew of the imperial dissatisfaction with him. The proprieties were observed and the Emperor was the first to set that example, but everybody understood that the old man was blameworthy and good-for-nothing. When Kutúzov, conforming to a custom of Catherine’s day, ordered the standards that had been captured to be lowered at the Emperor’s feet on his entering the ballroom, the Emperor made a wry face and muttered something in which some people caught the words, “the old comedian.”

cases.sentence: Когда на ___ утром государь сказал собравшимся у него офицерам — «Вы спасли не одну Россию; вы спасли Европу» — все уже тогда поняли, что война не кончена.
cases.explain: «другой день» — after the preposition «на», the accusative marks the direct object of the verb.
cases.translation: When on the following morning the Emperor said to the officers assembled about him: “You have not only saved Russia, you have saved Europe!” they all understood that the war was not ended.

cases.sentence: Он старался доказать государю невозможность набрания ___; говорил о тяжелом положении населений, о возможности неудач и т. п.
cases.explain: «новых войск» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Kutúzov alone would not see this and openly expressed his opinion that no fresh war could improve the position or add to the glory of Russia, but could only spoil and lower the glorious position that Russia had gained. He tried to prove to the Emperor the impossibility of levying fresh troops, spoke of the hardships already endured by the people, of the possibility of failure and so forth.

cases.sentence: При таком настроении, фельдмаршал естественно представлялся только помехой и тормозом ___.
cases.explain: «предстоящей войны» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: This being the field marshal’s frame of mind he was naturally regarded as merely a hindrance and obstacle to the impending war.

cases.sentence: С этою целью понемногу переформировался штаб, и вся ___ штаба Кутузова была уничтожена и перенесена к государю.
cases.explain: «существенная сила» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: With this object his staff was gradually reconstructed and its real strength removed and transferred to the Emperor. Toll, Konovnítsyn, and Ermólov received fresh appointments. Everyone spoke loudly of the field marshal’s great weakness and failing health.

cases.explain: «другие назначения» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: With this object his staff was gradually reconstructed and its real strength removed and transferred to the Emperor. Toll, Konovnítsyn, and Ermólov received fresh appointments. Everyone spoke loudly of the field marshal’s great weakness and failing health.

cases.sentence: Ему надо было быть ___, для того чтобы передать свое место тому, кто заступал его.
cases.explain: «слабым здоровьем» — the instrumental marks the means, company, or complement.
cases.translation: His health had to be bad for his place to be taken away and given to another. And in fact his health was poor.

cases.explain: «действительное здоровье» — the subject of the sentence stands in the nominative.
cases.translation: His health had to be bad for his place to be taken away and given to another. And in fact his health was poor.

cases.sentence: Война 1812-го года, кроме своего дорогого ___ народного значения, должна была иметь другое — европейское.
cases.explain: «русскому сердцу» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
cases.translation: The war of 1812, besides its national significance dear to every Russian heart, was now to assume another, a European, significance.

cases.sentence: Война 1812-го года, кроме своего дорогого русскому сердцу ___, должна была иметь другое — европейское.
cases.explain: «народного значения» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: The war of 1812, besides its national significance dear to every Russian heart, was now to assume another, a European, significance.

cases.sentence: Представителю ___, после того как враг был уничтожен, Россия освобождена и поставлена на высшую степень своей славы, русскому человеку, как русскому, делать больше было нечего.
cases.explain: «русского народа» — the genitive here marks possession, absence, or quantity.
cases.translation: Kutúzov did not understand what Europe, the balance of power, or Napoleon meant. He could not understand it. For the representative of the Russian people, after the enemy had been destroyed and Russia had been liberated and raised to the summit of her glory, there was nothing left to do as a Russian. Nothing remained for the representative of the national war but to die, and Kutúzov died.

cases.sentence: Представителю русского народа, после того как враг был уничтожен, Россия освобождена и поставлена на высшую степень своей славы, ___, как русскому, делать больше было нечего.
cases.explain: «русскому человеку» — the dative marks the indirect object or recipient.
